title: Best divers
intro_text: Ten watches with a rotating bezel and a water-resistance rating that means something, running from a quartz Casio to a Swiss automatic. Nine of the ten are rated to at least 200 m. The exception is the Seiko 5 Sports at 100 m, which is fine for swimming but is not the 200 m its case shape implies, and that is worth knowing before you buy it. Ordered cheapest first, because the interesting question in this category is how little you have to spend before you stop compromising, and the answer is less than most people expect.
